verdict.rationale: GitLab's SAST docs describe an agentic approach that resolves vulnerabilities with minimal human intervention, and the homepage claims agents remediate vulnerabilities, so fixes go beyond reports. The evidence is thin on how a developer reviews and applies a suggested fix, which findings and languages are covered, and what tier or add-on is required. missing for 10: documented workflow for applying a fix (e.g., auto-generated MR or inline suggestion), coverage and limitations of the auto-fix, tier/licensing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply suggested or automatic code fixes for findings instead of only reading reports

citations.quote: This agentic approach uses multi-shot reasoning to resolve vulnerabilities with minimal human intervention.
Teams orchestrate, agents execute, turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities, and reviewing code, all inside the guardrails you set.
